P.name: Junkyard Titan
P.title: Template:Data Rumble/Junkyard Titan
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Junkyard Titan|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Rumble
|skill        = I
|icon         = Junkyard Titan.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Rumble}} {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which gradually expires after a few seconds without generating Heat. Rumble enters the ''Danger Zone'' while he has at least {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' at {{tip|Heat|Max Heat}}.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|[[File:Junkyard Titan 2.png|24px]] Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' basic abilities are empowered.
|blurb3        = {{sbc|[[File:Junkyard Titan 3.png|24px]] Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' abilities are disabled as his {{tip|Heat}} decays over a few seconds. During this time, his basic attacks gain {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds. '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'' when at or above {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' while at {{tip|Heat|150 Heat}}.
|icon2        = Junkyard Titan 2.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'', empowering his basic abilities.
|icon3        = Junkyard Titan 3.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' mech becomes ''Overheated'', disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds. During this time, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|50+((130-50)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers his {{tip|basic attacks}} to deal {{pp|5 + (40-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|65+((150-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = Proc
|parry = True
|spellshield  = 
|notes = 
* While '''Rumble''' is ''overheating'', a [[File: Silence icon.png|20px]] ''Silenced'' icon will appear above him to signify he cannot cast {{tip|abilities}}. This is visible to all units.
* The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.
}}

|champion     = Rumble
|skill        = R
|icon         = The Equalizer.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rumble}} deploys a barrage of rockets along the target path that create a field which lingers for a few seconds.
|blurb2       = Enemies within the area are continually dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' deploys a barrage of rockets from the sky along the target path in a line over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each rocket impacts the ground to create a field of fire that lasts {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
|description2 = Enemies struck by the impact or within the field are marked ''Burning'' for 1 second, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds and being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%, refreshing while in the area. Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.
|leveling2    = 
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|{{#var:r_b1}}/4 to {{#var:r_b5}}/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|{{#var:r_b1}} to {{#var:r_b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:r_b1}}*5 to {{#var:r_b5}}*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:r_ap}}*5}}% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|130 to 80}}
|target range = 1700
|range        = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|-175|Damage range behind vector origin}}| {{tt|1135|Maximum damage range forward, estimated}}}}
|width        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|410 - {{fd|368.4}}|Widest and thinnest point of the chain of circles, respectively}}
|speed        = {{tt|1600|Vector deployment speed}}
|targeting    = Vector

|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = aoedot
|projectile   = false
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''The Equalizer's'' cumulative hitbox consists of a row of six rockets, each having a circular area of effect with a radius of 205 units. Each rocket drops at an offset of 180 units from the previous in the vector of cast.
** The missile that manages the rockets being deployed starts 150 units behind the target vector origin, and thus drops the first rocket at 30 units in front of the cast vector origin, which is equivalent to a period of {{rutngt|0.1125}} from the cast point.
* A given field checks for targets to apply or refresh the debuff on once every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* Due to each field expiring at different points in time, champions moving in the duration of the rockets' launch as they are expiring may sometimes receive 1 more instance of the debuff at most beyond the maximum.{{bug}}
}}
